newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ZAMBIA STOCKS WEEK- LIGHT VOLUMES TRADED ON BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: ZAMBIA STOCKS WEEK- LIGHT VOLUMES TRADED ON BOURSE.

text.p: Traded volume on the Lusaka Stock
Exchange fell last week, exchange officials said.
They said volume fell to 404,917 shares worth 5.12 million
kwacha from 3,05 million shares valued at over 130 million
Chilanga Cement gained one kwacha to end the week at 57
kwacha in a traded volume of 18,616 kwacha valued at 1.1 million
Zambia Sugar gained 0.75 kwacha to end the weeek at 13.25
kwacha and saw 69.200 shares valued at 882,450 kwacha changing
No other listed company traded during the week
